Which statement concerning the atrioventricular bundle is correct?
Option A: It is formed of autonomic nerve processes and is the only electrical connection between the atria and the ventricles.
Option B: It is formed of Purkinje fibres and is the only electrical connection between the atria and the ventricles
Option C: It is formed of autonomic nerve processes and forms one of several electrical connections between the atria and ventricles.
Option D: It is formed of Purkinje fibres and forms one of several electrical connections between the atria and ventricles.
